statement: RotRateAtTemperature is0 below0C,1 at or above10C,and T/10 between;0C is exactly zero and heat above10C does not accelerate this function.
Rottable defaults are2 days to rot,999 days to dessication,40 rot damage/day,false rotDestroys; thresholds RoundToInt(days*60000). Fresh uses progress<threshold; equality advances stage.

Active CompRottable adds unrounded ambient-rate*delta; CompTickRare supplies250. Selected raw foods inherit Rare from OrganicProductBase,meals from MealBaseIngredientless. Normal interval uses actual delta,not a fixed250 each tick.

After advancing,Stage==Rotting and rotDestroys destroys the entire Thing; Thing.Destroy notifies holdingOwner and clears non-pawn stackCount. Storage message requires actual storage and a spawned root. General dessicated/corpse damage has a separate branch,not an unconditional progress>=rot threshold destroy rule.

Before stack counts change,receiver rot progress lerps toward donor progress by transferredCount/(receiverCount+transferredCount). Only transferred units participate; a donor remainder keeps its existing progress. This is quantity-weighted age,not oldest-age or freshness reset.

SplitOff makes a separate Thing only for a partial split,then PostSplitOff copies the source RotProgress unchanged. Whole-stack removal returns the same object. Container transfer uses SplitOff and TryAdd,with leftover restoration; transfer is not a new freshness event.

Base stack eligibility requires live Item Things,same Def and Stuff,and no relic; components may further reject. CompRottable does not override the default true AllowStackWith. Respecting limit transfers min(donor count,limit-receiver count). Raw crop base limit75 and meal base10; rice and corn have different Defs and cannot combine merely because both are grain.

AmbientTemperature reads own spawned cell first,then fixed-temperature parent holders,then spawned root PositionHeld/MapHeld,then world tile,finally21C. Ordinary carried food follows the carrier location; stock-zone membership is not a temperature source.

Thing.DoTick recurses child holders; Pawn enumerates inventory/carry/equipment/apparel. ThingOwner.DoTick calls each item's DoTick and removes destroyed contents. Held Rare items are hash-gated at250 ticks; CarryHandsTickInterval and InventoryTrackerTick are not their rot scheduler.
Fixed14C applies to inventory objects with CompHatcher,specified launch/transporter holders,and settlement trader/trade ship holders. It does not apply to all ordinary pawn inventory food.

Ticking contents can stop through ThingOwner.dontTickContents,IThingHolderTickable.ShouldTickContents,false active rot,or enclosing cryptosleep/ISuspendableThingHolder. These are distinct from temperature freezing and do not erase stored progress.
CompRottable saves the float progress as rotProg and disabled as a bool; it has one progress for a whole stack,not a timestamp or per-unit age array.

Selected Core RawRice40d,RawPotatoes30d,RawCorn60d each declare CompProperties_Rottable and rotDestroys true. The selected parent chain has no conflicting replacement; patches and active Def databases are outside this extraction.

MealSimple inherits MealCooked then MealCookedIngredientless then MealBaseIngredientless. Rottable is declared on MealCookedIngredientless with4 days and rotDestroys true; this installed version is not a3-day definition.

MealSurvivalPack->MealBase->MealBaseIngredientless contains no CompProperties_Rottable in these complete selected comps roots. Survival-pack DeteriorationRate0.25 is a separate HP deterioration declaration,not a rot lifespan. No claim is made about arbitrary patched food definitions.

Ordinary listed recipe products are new ThingMaker instances; ingredient tracking records Defs,not ingredient rot progress. CompRottable default float starts0 and has no recipe-produced override. Toils_Recipe calculates physical ingredient Things then creates products and consumes ingredients. This is the inspected simple-meal path,not every special recipe or mod.

Storage priorities order Unstored0,Low1,Normal2,Preferred3,Important4,Critical5. Ordinary better-slot search requires strictly higher current priority and allowed/reachable/reservable space. Temperature is not part of the inspected selection rule; equal-priority cold storage alone does not create an upgrade haul.

StorageSettings accepts only when its ThingFilter and any parent storage filter accept. ThingFilter checks allowed Defs,configured HP/quality and disallowed special filters. Stock selection and cooking-bill ingredient permissions remain separate settings.

Fresh filter accepts non-drug ingestibles without rottable or rottables at Fresh stage. Rotten filter excludes rotDestroys items and only matches persistent rottables beyond Fresh. These filters do not implement a numerical near-expiry threshold or automatic oldest-food-first hauling.

Inspect countdown rounds ambient temperature to integer before applying rot rate; actual age accumulation uses unrounded temperature. Inactive or zero-rate estimate returns72000000 ticks as sentinel; frozen food is not restored to fresh progress. UI labels at subdegree boundaries are not exact physics evidence.
